text: zoom works but right click actions didnt land at all it seems
resolution: Fixed the UV right-click menu that was rendering off-screen. useContextMenu captures window coordinates, while UvEditor renders its popup inside the inspector's local absolute containing block; the prior implementation only nudged the global X and left global Y untouched. The editor now measures the UV panel, converts both axes to panel-local coordinates, opens toward the stage, and clamps the collapsed/expanded menu to the panel. Added focused regression coverage for a real right-side panel placement.
